name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
summary: Varimathras in the Undercity asks you to strike at Scarlet leaders and champions. Their defeat matters enough that he expects you to report back.

sections.title: A Report for Varimathras
sections.body: Varimathras sends you against four Scarlet figures: High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion, and Houndmaster Loksey. Once they are slain, you are to report back to him in the Undercity.

faq.answer: Varimathras gives it and expects you to report back to him in the Undercity.

faq.q: Who am I supposed to defeat?
faq.answer: The named targets are High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion, and Houndmaster Loksey.
Report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.

attribution: In-game quest text: Into The Scarlet Monastery
